notes.title: Patch Notes Update. Elizabeth's Voice. Tutorial localization issues.
notes.content:
Patch Notes Update
Date: 21.05.2024

Highlights:

Elizabeth's Voice Change: We've updated Elizabeth's voice to enhance the gaming experience. Enjoy a fresh new sound while playing!
Localization Fixes: Various issues with tutorial localization have been addressed to ensure a smoother and more accurate experience for players across ukranian languages.
Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. Happy gaming!
